answer: Time-locked witness quorum. Each new agent identity must be co-signed by five existing agents who each surrender one marble — a non-transferable token minted only by sustained correct behavior over weeks. Signatures are sealed in a vault that releases them only after a 30-day challenge window, so colluding signers cannot recycle identities quickly. A raven audit randomly samples quorums and voids bad ones, destroying the marbles and the signers' standing.
